name: Battle of Love
source:
"I’m kinda reluctant about the idea, but I like you. I’m kinda reluctant, but please go out with me"

The heroine,Maiko, was suddenly confessed to by her glasses-wearing classmate, Shimizu Junya. Since she had never thought about any stuff involving that when it comes to him, she rejects him with a "No, I refuse". Junya, who didn’t like the reply, asks her out on a day long date with "I demand a one day long date from you, who responded like that!"

"Hmmm, well, if it’s just one day…" The irresponsible heroine accepts that date, but…

This is the story of that date, that was done while having an unclear relationship.

[from [url=https://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/09/24/otome-game-review-tics-special/]Koorin's blog[/url]]
translation:
“我有点犹豫，但我喜欢你。虽然有些犹豫，还是请和我交往吧。”

女主角麻衣子突然被戴眼镜的同班同学清水纯也告白。她从未把两人之间的关系往恋爱方向想过，于是回答：“不，我拒绝。”纯也不喜欢这个答案，便约她进行一整天的约会：“我要你和这样回答我的人约会一整天！”

“嗯……如果只有一天的话……”

不负责任的女主角接受了约会，但……

这就是两人在关系暧昧的状态下度过的约会故事。

[来源：[url=https://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/09/24/otome-game-review-tics-special/]Koorin's blog[/url]]
